note: The name of migration M4, which the progress screen shows while it runs. The migration has no interactive step and no other UI strings; its report (the reason a legacy subject, paper, session or mark could not be mapped, the assumption behind an assessment's kind or status, the score values it kept as a level) stays English on purpose, because a data migration has no access to the translation layer and the operator sees those lines as data diagnostics. The wave merge must unwrap the `en.common` wrapper and merge the children into the central `common` namespace (do not copy the wrapper). Translate for fr, rw, sw.

migration.m4Name: Migrate the exam sessions and results into assessments, marks and results
